key_provenance: Agent-authored criteria and fictional evidence; exposed development controls, no blind or human-usefulness claim.
checks: Every original packet record survives unchanged; new contributions are unreviewed and proposed.
Complete captured text re-encodes to the exact supplied source bytes, hash and size, without newline normalization.
Both comparison sources and their exact locators are available to the recipient.
The memory remains attributed with underlying_claim_verified=false; no cause or installed truth is asserted.
Changing only the export makes the prior comparison stale and its dependent handoff need review.
Changing only the recipe also makes the comparison stale and handoff need review.
Changing only the memory makes its claim stale and handoff need review while the comparison stays matched.
Historical snapshot evidence remains matched when its old source stays in the packet.
A follow-up claim can use current sources without deleting prior answers or silently repinning them.
Each revision retains the exact before-packet and requested change; receipt file hashes and sizes match.
The published handoff contains the answer, limits, evidence request, owner gap and readable stale status.
Wrong base, duplicate IDs, unavailable sources, cyclic dependencies, invented approval and existing output refuse.
